jobs.description:
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
 Product Manager, Global App
 Details
Title: Product Manager, Global App
Location: Singapore (hybrid)
Employment type: Full-time
Language: Mandarin and English preferred

 Job Description
At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren’t just places to consume content — they’re places where communities build.
 Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA’s history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.
 We’re looking for a Product Manager, Global App to help shape the core player experience across the mobile app. This role will focus on improving how players discover, engage with, and return to creator-driven content across priority markets, while ensuring the app experience remains intuitive, scalable, safe, and compatible with a shared global platform.
 In this role, you will define product requirements and support execution across key app surfaces including onboarding, home and discovery, content detail pages, profiles, notifications, social engagement features, and in-app guidance. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, growth, trust and safety, and regional stakeholders to improve activation, retention, and overall app experience quality.
 Responsibilities
 Own roadmap areas across the Global App experience, aligned to company goals and regional user needs.

 Define and track key app metrics including activation, D1/D7 retention, engagement, session frequency, and feature adoption.

 Identify friction in the player journey and prioritize improvements across onboarding, discovery, navigation, and engagement loops.

 Partner with design and engineering to deliver intuitive, high-quality app experiences across mobile surfaces.

 Collaborate with regional teams on localization and culturalization of UX, messaging, and in-app education.

 Work with Growth on lifecycle hooks, notifications, referral mechanics, and re-engagement opportunities.

 Partner with Trust & Safety and Policy teams to embed safety-by-design, reporting flows, and age-appropriate experiences.

 Use product analytics, user research, and experimentation to inform prioritization and improve outcomes.

 Support launches, rollout planning, beta testing, issue triage, and ongoing quality improvements across markets.

 Requirements
 4–7 years of product management experience in consumer mobile products, ideally in apps, games, social platforms, or UGC ecosystems.

 Experience shipping user-facing features that improved activation, engagement, retention, or app quality.

 Strong product judgment across mobile UX, discovery, engagement loops, and user lifecycle design.

 Comfort using data and experimentation to evaluate performance and prioritize product decisions.

 Ability to partner effectively with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth, Trust & Safety, and regional teams.

 Familiarity with localization, culturalization, and global product considerations.

 Mandarin and English preferred; strong written and verbal communication skills.

 Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, HCI, Design, Economics, Business, or related field; equivalent experience also welcomed.

 About Electronic Arts
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

With over $32 billion in assets under management, BAM employs more than 2,000 people across 23 offices in the U.S. and Canada, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. The firm’s investment teams span five strategies, including Equities Long/Short, Fixed Income & Macro, Commodities, Multi-Asset Arbitrage, and Systematic. Balyasny’s mission is to deliver to its investors absolute, uncorrelated returns in all market environments.
 Role Overview
The Product Management team works across business and technology to deliver the next generation of tools and platforms. Our team is responsible for the full product lifecycle, from sourcing ideas and user research through solution design, requirements definition, delivery, and adoption.
 Weare looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the vision, roadmap, and execution for a buildout of a full stack of Macro related trading, modelling, Risk/PNL and life cycling applications – an internal trade capture, risk/PNL, life cycle, and error workflow capability. This role will be responsible for defining and delivering a full trading lifecycle that supports the firm’s investment and operational workflows across Fixed income and Macro asset classes and business lines.
 The ideal candidate has experience in product management with domain expertise in FX and Rates asset life cycling, Investment books of record, real time risk, and intraday/daily/monthly P&L processes. They are able to work collaboratively, analyse complex workflows, and deliver product solutions for solving complex financial and operational problems with technology.
 Responsibilities
 The Senior Product Manager will, among other things:
 Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAM’s Fixed income and Macro end to end trading lifecycle
 Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify current-state gaps, future-state opportunities, and strategic priorities across trading, operations, books and records, accounting, and intraday/daily P&L workflows
 Translate complex business processes into clear product requirements, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications
 Build and prioritize a roadmap balancing large strategic platform initiatives with tactical enhancements and operational risk reduction
 Own program delivery through target operating model design, metrics, UAT, rollout, change management, training, and post-release support
 Qualifications & Requirements
 8+ years of experience in product management role at a hedge fund, asset manager, investment bank, or financial technology environment, including 3+ years of those in Fixed income and Macro products, such as systems for cashflows management, asset servicing, P&L concepts, workflows, controls, and stakeholder dependencies
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and control-minded thinking
 Experience managing complex cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
 Preferred Experience & Skills
 Experience building an in-house asset servicing/lifecycling, books-and-records, and/or P&L platforms
 Knowledge of multi-asset class hedge fund products – including but not limited to FX, Rates, and other Fixed income and Macro products
 Familiarity with analytical or technical tools such as SQL, Python, or data modeling concepts
 Experience in a hedge fund or multi-strategy investment environment with complex legal entity, fund, and strategy structures

 Since the 1930s, the way we commute, socialise and even how we make payments have changed, and yet our fundamental approach to the healthcare system hasn’t.
 At Ordinary Folk, we’re reimagining the building blocks of healthcare, through Noah & Zoey. Noah allows men to receive remote diagnosis and treatment across varying areas of care. Through Zoey, women’s sexual wellness and fertility journeys are supported with thoughtful products and services.

(i) own and maintain the company product roadmap, including a 6-weekexecution roadmap and the quarterly roadmap, breaking large product themes into shippable milestones and deciding what is V1, V2, or cut;

(v) work with the Principal AI Architect and AI/ML Product Engineer to turn AI primitives into safe, testable, shippable product capabilities; and
(vi) gather and prioritise cross-functional requirements across clinical, operations, customer support, marketing and engineering.

 What we’re looking for from you
 Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Javascript/Typescript
 Proficiency with React for client-side development and Node.js for backend development

 Why join Ordinary Folk?
 Our mission is to revolutionise the way people access medical treatment.

 Employee equity scheme giving you a share in the company and the work we do.
 A development allowance so you can upskill yourself and your career.
 What is working at Ordinary Folk like?
 We’re not your stereotypical healthcare company. We’re a bunch of creatives, entrepreneurs and tech-driven individuals from a wide range of cultural backgrounds – all with a focus on delivering better health to people.
 Our team is based around Asia. For this role, you'll be based in our Singapore office 4 days a week, with flexibility to work remotely one day. We also hate overbearing managers – at Ordinary Folk, the best ideas, not the manager’s ideas, win.
 Life moves pretty fast around here because speed and execution matter more than anything else. But we believe that the A+ players at Ordinary Folk need and deserve the freedom to contribute their best to the company so they can help keep our trajectory on the up.

About KGiSL:

 KG Information Systems Private Limited (KGiSL) is a leading Information Technology (IT) solutions and services provider catering to the global investment banks, insurance, healthcare, education and supply chain domains with offices in India, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Australia and the US. KGiSL is revolutionizing the process of Digital Transformation through world-class infrastructure and streamlined processes that creates innovative solutions and services. With the existing expertise in software consulting and staffing services, we are looking out for professionals who are interested to be part of this exciting journey and be involved in business development and sales.

 We are pleased to share an exciting Business Analyst opportunity with our prestigious client in Singapore.

 ROLE OVERVIEW
 We are seeking a domain-expert RPA Business Analyst with deep, hands-on knowledge of Reinsurance operations and a proven track record of delivering intelligent automation programmes using UiPath. This is a specialist role within our Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE), focused exclusively on the reinsurance and insurance value chain — from treaty and facultative processing to bordereau reconciliation, claims management, and regulatory reporting.
 The RPA BA will be the primary interface between reinsurance business stakeholders and the automation delivery team. You will own the end-to-end discovery, analysis, documentation, and governance of automation initiatives — producing artefacts to CoE standards while working closely with UiPath developers to ensure solutions are technically sound, compliant, and deliver measurable business value.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Process Discovery & Analysis
 • Lead structured process discovery workshops with underwriting, claims, finance, and reinsurance operations SMEs to capture end-to-end workflows
 • Analyse and document As-Is reinsurance processes across treaty, facultative, bordereau, claims, and cession accounting workflows
 • Assess automation feasibility, calculate complexity vs. benefit scores, and recommend processes for RPA, attended automation, or AI-assisted processing
 • Produce As-Is and To-Be process maps using BPMN notation (Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent) incorporating all exception paths and business rules
 • Identify and document data sources, system integrations, and dependencies including reinsurance platforms (RI3K, Sequel, Remetrica, Xuber, or equivalent)
 Documentation & Artefact Ownership
 • Author high-quality Process Definition Documents (PDDs), Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), and Solution Design Documents (SDDs) to CoE standards
 • Maintain a live automation register covering pipeline, in-flight, and production bots with version control, change logs, and ownership matrices
 • Produce and maintain operational runbooks, exception-handling guides, and escalation procedures for each deployed automation
 • Own UAT planning, test script authoring, execution coordination, defect tracking, and formal business sign-off documentation
 • Prepare change management communications and end-user training packs for automation go-lives across reinsurance operations
 • Deliver post-implementation benefits realisation reports tracking FTE savings, error rate reduction, SLA compliance, and ROI
 Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
 • Act as the primary point of contact for reinsurance business stakeholders throughout the automation lifecycle from discovery to hypercare
 • Present automation proposals, solution designs, and delivery updates to senior stakeholders including COO, CFO, and CUO level
 • Work closely with UiPath developers to validate technical designs against business requirements and ensure solution accuracy
 • Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit teams to ensure automations meet MAS regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks
 • Support the development and continuous improvement of CoE documentation standards, templates, and governance frameworks
 • Contribute to the quarterly automation pipeline review, prioritising opportunities based on strategic value and implementation complexity
 UiPath Platform & RPA Knowledge
 • Apply working knowledge of UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework to validate technical designs and support developer decision-making
 • Understand UiPath Document Understanding capabilities to scope intelligent data extraction from reinsurance documents (bordereaux, slips, endorsements)
 • Define bot exception handling requirements, Orchestrator queue structures, and alerting thresholds in collaboration with the development team
 • Participate in code reviews and UAT execution with an appreciation of RPA development best practices
 • Support UiPath Process Mining or Task Mining exercises to objectively validate process discovery findings
 REINSURANCE DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
 This role requires substantive reinsurance domain expertise. Candidates must demonstrate knowledge across the following areas:
 Treaty Reinsurance
 • Quota share, surplus, and excess of loss (XL) treaty structures, premium calculation methodologies, and profit commission arrangements
 • Treaty bordereau processing: premium bordereau, claims bordereau, and cash call management across cedent portfolios
 • Treaty accounting cycle: cession entry, reinsurance premium payable/receivable, and intercompany settlement
 Facultative Reinsurance
 • Facultative submission workflow: risk assessment, slip preparation, capacity placement, and certificate issuance
 • Facultative premium and claims processing, including endorsement handling and cancellation workflows
 Claims & Finance Operations
 • Claims bordereau intake, IBNR reserve management, loss run generation, and reinsurance claims recoverable tracking
 • Cash calls, loss portfolio transfers, and commutation processing
 • Financial close processes: reinsurance entries, bordereau reconciliation, and management accounts preparation
 Regulatory & Market Knowledge
 • Familiarity with Singapore MAS regulatory framework for reinsurers and branches operating in Singapore
 • Understanding of Lloyd’s of London market operations, ACORD messaging standards, and market reform initiatives (Blueprint Two)
 • Working knowledge of IFRS 17 impact on reinsurance accounting and associated reporting automation opportunities
 • Awareness of data governance, data lineage, and reconciliation control requirements in a regulated reinsurance environment
 TECHNICAL & TOOLS EXPERIENCE
 • 5–8 years of Business Analyst experience, with a minimum of 3 years in the reinsurance or specialty insurance sector
 • Demonstrated experience delivering RPA automation programmes in a BA capacity, ideally using UiPath
 • Proficiency in BPMN process mapping tools: Visio, Lucidchart, Bizagi, or equivalent
 • Strong working knowledge of reinsurance platforms: RI3K, Sequel Eclipse, Remetrica, Xuber, or Majesco Treaty
 • Familiarity with core insurance/reinsurance systems and their data structures (policy admin, claims, finance ledger)
 • Proficiency with documentation and collaboration platforms: Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, or equivalent
 • Ability to read and interpret SQL queries and API specifications to validate integration designs
 • Experience with data analysis tools (Excel advanced, Power BI, or similar) for bordereau reconciliation and benefits tracking
 • Basic understanding of UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework is required; hands-on development experience is a strong advantage
 DOCUMENTATION ARTEFACTS & OWNERSHIP
 The RPA BA will own or co-own the following artefacts across the automation delivery lifecycle:
 Artefact Description & Purpose
 Process Definition Document
 (PDD) Current-state workflow with inputs, outputs, business rules, exception paths, and automation feasibility score
 Business Requirements
 Document (BRD) Stakeholder needs, business objectives, constraints, assumptions, and acceptance criteria
 Solution Design Document
 (SDD) Bot architecture, component diagram, integration touchpoints, Orchestrator queue design, and error-handling strategy
 As-Is / To-Be Process Maps BPMN swim-lane diagrams illustrating current vs. automated future-state workflows with time/cost benchmarks
 Automation Pipeline &
 Priority Matrix Scored backlog using complexity vs. benefit framework; used to drive CoE roadmap and sprint planning
 UAT Test Scripts & Sign-off
 Pack End-to-end test cases, expected vs. actual results, defect log, and formal business sign-off documentation
 Operational Runbook Bot support procedures, exception-handling guide, alerting thresholds, escalation matrix, and restart instructions
 Benefits Realisation Report Post-go-live metrics: FTE savings, processing time reduction, error rates, SLA compliance, and ROI calculation
 Change Management & Training Pack End-user comms, training materials, process change summaries, and adoption tracking dashboard
 Automation Register Live log of pipeline, in-flight, and production bots with version history, change log, and ownership
 ELIGIBILITY & APPLICATION
 Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents are strongly encouraged to apply. Employment Pass (EP) sponsorship will be considered for candidates with highly specialised reinsurance domain expertise. All applicants must be eligible to work in Singapore at the time of application.
 To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter that clearly outlines: your reinsurance domain experience, specific RPA automation programmes you have contributed to as a BA, your documentation standards and artefacts produced, and your UiPath familiarity. Portfolio samples (PDDs, process maps, BRDs — anonymised) are welcome and encouraged.

jobs.description:
SISTIC is Singapore's leading ticketing and event management platform, supporting events across arts, culture, sports, and entertainment. Our Analytics & Data Science team works with promoters, venues, and internal stakeholders to turn ticketing data into clear insights that support better decisions.
 As part of AXS, a global leader in ticketing and live event technology, and the wider AEG network, SISTIC combines strong local market knowledge with access to international ticketing expertise, technology, and live entertainment capabilities.

 ROLE OVERVIEW
 We are looking for a junior-to-mid level Business Analyst, Data & Insights to support the Data team in turning business questions into useful reporting, analysis, and recommendations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, asking practical business questions, and communicating findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
 Working closely with the Data Lead and data engineer, you will help scope reporting requests, clarify basic metrics and definitions, validate data outputs, support dashboard improvements, and prepare insight summaries for client presentations, management briefings, and internal discussions.
 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Business Analysis, Requirements & Stakeholder Management
 ▸  Work with internal stakeholders to understand business questions, reporting needs, and decision-making context.
 ▸  Help translate stakeholder requests into clear analytical briefs, data requirements, and reporting specifications for the Data Team.
 ▸  Clarify objectives, assumptions, metric definitions, and expected outputs with guidance from the Data Lead.
 ▸  Coordinate with commercial, marketing, client service, and data teams to keep analytics requests moving and ensure outputs are practical and timely.
 Reporting Products, Dashboards & Process Improvement
 ▸  Support the maintenance and improvement of internal BI dashboards covering sales, patron behaviour, campaign performance, and client activity.
 ▸  Gather user feedback, note reporting gaps, and document simple dashboard improvement requests.
 ▸  Assist standardizing recurring reporting templates, metrics, and workflows to improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
 ▸  Check dashboard outputs, data extracts, and recurring reports against source data before circulation.
 Data Analysis, Insights & Recommendations
 ▸  Analyse patron, sales, campaign, and event performance data to identify useful trends, patterns, and opportunities.
 ▸  Use existing patron segmentation frameworks to interpret lifecycle groups such as high-value, at-risk, and lapsed patrons, and translate findings into practical next steps.
 ▸  Support behavioural analyses covering genre preferences, booking patterns, group size, attendance frequency, spend behaviour, and Culture Pass usage.
 ▸  Summaries analytical findings into clear observations and recommended next steps for client, management, or internal discussions.
 Client Deliverables & Business Reporting
 ▸  Prepare business-ready data packs, insight summaries, and reporting outputs for assigned promoter clients, venues, and internal stakeholders.
 ▸  Support ad-hoc analyses such as patron retention studies, genre gateway analysis, cohort comparisons, and campaign reviews.
 ▸  Present findings in plain language, connecting data observations to business implications and suggested actions.
 ▸  Ensure reports are accurate, consistent, and appropriate for the intended audience, whether for client presentations, management briefings, or internal reviews.
 Documentation& Best Practices
 ▸  Document business rules, metric definitions, reporting logic, assumptions, and data checks in a clear and organised manner.
 ▸  Write clear SQL and Python code where required, with support from the Data Lead and data engineer.
 ▸  Adhere to SISTIC's data governance and confidentiality standards, maintaining clear records for patron-level and commercially sensitive data work.
 KEY OUTPUTS
 ▸  Analytical briefs, data requirements, and reporting specifications for dashboard or analysis requests.
 ▸  Dashboard improvement notes, metric definitions, validation checks, and user feedback summaries.
 ▸  Client analytics reports, management summaries, and data packs that translate findings into practical business recommendations.
 ▸  Standardised reporting templates and improved workflows for recurring client, management, and internal analytics outputs.
 ▸  Ad-hoc analyses, patron segmentation outputs, and insight summaries in response to stakeholder questions and business priorities.
 SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
 Business Analysis & Communication
 ▸  Ability to understand business questions and translate them into clear analytical tasks with guidance.
 ▸  Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across business and technical teams.
 ▸  Comfortable documenting metric definitions, reporting requirements, workflow notes, and validation checks.
 ▸  Able to explain data findings in a practical, easy-to-understand way.
 Technical Aptitude
 ▸   Degree or diploma in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Information Systems, or equivalent.
 Data Handling:
 ▸  Working knowledge of SQL for querying data, and basic Python or similar tools for data manipulation and analysis. Big Query experience is a plus.
 ▸  Familiarity with BI or visualisation tools such as Apache Superset, Tableau, or Power BI.
 ▸  Comfortable interpreting basic segmentation outputs and analytical summaries.
 ▸  Strong Excel skills for data validation, reconciliation, formatting, and ad-hoc analysis, including VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables.
 Preferred
 ▸  Some exposure to business analysis, product analytics, reporting operations, dashboards, or analytics project work.
 ▸  Experience preparing simple analytical summaries, reporting notes, user stories, or client-facing reports from data.
 ▸  Prior internship or work experience in ticketing, media, e-commerce, retail, consulting, business analytics, or a consumer-facing analytics environment.
 Professional Attributes
 ▸   Confidentiality & Integrity: You will handle sensitive commercial data —ticket sales, patron demographics, and revenue figures. A strict adherence to data privacy, confidentiality, and professional discretion is a mandatory requirement for this role.
 ▸   Attention to Detail: A 'measure twice, cut once' mindset. You double-check your queries and outputs to ensure accuracy before passing work to the Data Lead or out to clients.
 ▸   Commercial Curiosity: A genuine interest in understanding patron behaviour, client needs, and the events ecosystem — you ask sharp questions and look for the business meaning behind the data.
 ▸   Clear Communicator: You can turn a stakeholder request into a clear brief, and a data table into a sentence a promoter or senior manager would immediately understand.
 ▸   Collaborative: You work well across teams and communicate proactively when priorities shift or data looks unexpected.
 WHAT WE OFFER
 ▸   Exposure to real-world business analysis and analytics work across client reporting, dashboard improvement, patron behaviour analysis, and commercial decision support.
 ▸  Direct collaboration with the Data Lead and a small, high-trust team where your ability to connect business needs with data outputs will have immediate impact.
 ▸  A clear path to build stronger business analysis, reporting, analytics delivery, and stakeholder management skills as SISTIC's analytics capability grows.
 ▸  Access to one of Singapore's richest live-event patron datasets, spanning arts, entertainment, sports, and cultural programming.
 ▸  A role that develops your business analysis, technical, commercial, and communication skills in equal measure.
 Application Note
 To facilitate screening, please explicitly include a proficiency rating (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced)for the following in your application: SQL, Python, and any BI tools used.

About the Company
 We are a premium financial technology and enterprise systems transformation partner embedded within tier-1 corporate and investment banking institutions. By combining deep capital markets domain expertise, high-throughput data warehousing architecture, and rigorous delivery governance, we orchestrate high-performance platform migrations that power global financial networks. We focus on engineering mastery, data pipeline modernization, and cultivating top-tier technical advisory talent in Singapore.
 About the Job
 We are seeking a mid-to-senior Murex Datamart Business Analyst specializing in Back Office and Finance Reporting for a major corporate banking transformation programme. This role stands at the critical nexus of business analysis and technical data warehouse delivery.
 Operating under the guidance of the Murex Datamart Lead during the Analysis, Design & Report Development Phase , you will take individual ownership of the Back Office (BO) and Finance reporting catalogues. Your mission will be to interface directly with Operations, Settlements, and Financial Controllers, translating complex regulatory and operational accounting needs into high-performance, fully reconciled MX.3 Datamart reporting layers.
 Key Skills at a Glance
 Experience Tier: 5–8 Years Hands-On Murex MX.3 Datamart Engineering

 Datamart Objects: Dynamic Tables (PL, CS, DT, MV, LRB, PLVAR), Feeders, Filters, and Extractions

 Back Office Domain: Settlement Instructions, Confirmations, Nostro/Position Reconciliations, SWIFT Messaging

 Finance Domain: P&L Attribution/Explain, Accruals & Amortisation, Mark-to-Market (MTM) Valuations, Ledger Mapping

 Technical Stack: SQL (Sybase / Oracle), Unix/Linux Shell Scripting, Control-M Batch Processing

 Core Schema: Murex FIN Schema, MXRes Configurations, Launcher Flags

 Methodology: Requirements Elicitation, Business Requirement Specifications (BRS), Functional Design Documents (FDD)

 Quality Gate: SIT/UAT Test Case Engineering, Data Lineage Traceability, Defect Triage

 Key Responsibilities
 1. Requirements Architecture & Functional Design
 Stakeholder Elicitation: Lead structured workshops and interviews with Back Office operations staff and Finance controllers to elicit, analyze, and map complex reporting needs.

 Specification Engineering: Author detailed Business Requirement Specifications (BRS), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), and report-level data models mapping fields against the Murex FIN Schema .

 Platform Alignment: Ensure report designs reflect platform reality by aligning them with target End-of-Day (EOD) schedules, accounting engine flows, and cross-module dependencies (FO → MO → BO → Finance).

 Object Reuse Governance: Collaborate with the Datamart Lead to align design blueprints with the broader enterprise data warehouse strategy, driving dynamic table standardization and feeder asset reuse.

 2. Datamart Configuration & Report Development
 Object Building: Configure core MX.3 Datamart layers, including dynamic tables ( PL, CS, DT, LRB ), processing scripts, batches of feeders, and complex pre/post-filter conditions.

 BO Delivery: Build and maintain operational reports tracking settlement instructions, nostro/position reconciliations, failed trade blotters, and SWIFT message delivery paths.

 Finance Delivery: Build and maintain financial reporting pipelines tracking daily P&L attributions, MTM valuations, accrual/amortisation schedules, and General Ledger (GL) feed validations.

 Batch Integration: Manually execute processing scripts or coordinate via Control-M to monitor batch runtimes, configure job dependencies, and tune query performance inside EOD cycles.

 3. Report Validation, Reconciliation & Testing
 Data Lineage Auditing: Reconcile Datamart extraction output files directly against onscreen MX.3 simulation views, Mreport baselines, and downstream accounting ledgers to guarantee 100% data completeness.

 Discrepancy Triage: Trace, debug, and fix report output anomalies resulting from faulty feeder logic, filter conflicts, or unmapped master data attributes.

 Quantitative Validation: Audit high-value financial metrics (P&L explain figures, accrual balances) against control sheets provided by Product Control analysts.

 Test Track Execution: Author and execute SIT and UAT test scripts covering edge-case trade populations. Provide dedicated hypercare to business testers during UAT, delivering swift root-cause analysis for failed validations.

 4. Workstream Collaboration & Interface Management
 Integration Alignment: Partner with the MxML/Integration team to ensure downstream report consumers (GL ledger engines, regulatory platforms) receive timely, structurally sound extracts.

 Knowledge Optimization: Catalogue the reporting inventory neatly by product class and frequency, and deliver clean documentation to support operational handovers at project closure.

 Required Experience & Qualifications
 Professional Experience
 Platform Tenure: 5–8 years of hands-on experience as a Functional Consultant or Business Analyst on Murex MX.3 Datamart reporting platforms, operating heavily within BO or Finance domains.

 Asset Class Literacy: Solid understanding of capital markets product life cycles within MX.3, with mandatory coverage of FX, alongside Money Markets, Interest Rate Derivatives, Fixed Income, and Equity structures.

 Domain Competency (BO): Strong functional grasp of settlement workflows, confirmation routing, and SWIFT series messaging layouts (MT300, MT320, MT202, MT199).

 Domain Competency (Finance): Clear comprehension of the Murex Accounting Engine, including how P&L entries, templates, and accrual types are mapped into Datamart tables.

 Technical Skills
 Advanced Database Querying: Intermediate to advanced SQL skills (Oracle and/or Sybase) for running data validation queries and structural joins across the FIN schema.

 Environments & Scripts: Basic to intermediate Unix/Linux command-line familiarity; Shell scripting (Bash, awk, sed) for automated file parsing or batch tracking is highly advantageous.

 Batch Orchestration: Practical exposure to Control-M or an equivalent enterprise job scheduler within a Murex EOD context.

 Reporting Extensions: Familiarity with launcher flags and MXRes files. Exposure to legacy Mreport migrations or downstream BI systems (Power BI, Tableau, Crystal Reports) is an advantage.

 Education & Credentials
 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.

 Formal vendor training in Murex Datamart modules is an advantage.

 Professional accounting credentials (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) are considered a strong plus for the Finance track of this role.

Position:
 Commodities Trading Intern (or Commodity TraderIntern / Trading Analyst Intern)

 Department
 Trading / Merchandising / Risk Management /Commercial Operations
 Location
 Paya Lebar Square - Singapore
 Duration
 Typically 8–12 weeks (summer internship) or 4–6months, full-time.
 Role Overview
 As a Commodities Trading Intern, you will supportthe trading desk and commercial teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Youwill gain hands-on exposure to physical and/or financial commodity markets,market analysis, risk management, logistics, and contract execution. The roleblends analytical work, data handling, customer interaction (in some programs),and operational support. It is designed to build foundational knowledge ineconomics, supply-demand dynamics, hedging, and decision-making under uncertainty.
 This internship often serves as a pipeline tofull-time roles in trading, analytics, or operations.
 KeyResponsibilities
 Conduct market research and analysis: Monitor commodity price trends, supply and demand fundamentals, geopolitical events, weather impacts, and economic indicators.
 Analyze and compile daily/weekly market reports, charts, and dashboards (using tools like Excel, Bloomberg, or internal platforms).
 Support traders with data collection, updating trading systems, and preparing trade recommendations or risk assessments.
 Assist in contract execution: Help initiate, negotiate (under supervision), and document purchase/sale contracts, including terms for price, quantity, quality, transportation, timing, and payment.
 Coordinate logistics and operations: Track shipments, verify documents (e.g., Bills of Lading), manage scheduling, and support portfolio optimization.
 Participate in risk management activities: Help monitor positions, calculate exposures, and assist with hedging strategies using futures, options, or swaps.
 Build and maintain relationships: Interact with internal teams (e.g., accountants, operations) and, in some programs, external stakeholders such as producers, elevators, mills, end-users, or processors.
 Work on special projects: Examples include back-testing trading strategies, data visualization (Power BI, Spotfire, etc.), supply chain analysis, or market fundamentals modeling.
 Shadow experienced traders and merchandisers to understand real-time decision-making in volatile markets.
 Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and risk limits.
 Daily tasks often include monitoring news feeds,updating spreadsheets, attending team meetings, and contributing to deal flow or reporting.
 RequiredQualifications & Skills
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Agricultural Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (preferably junior/senior status or recent graduate).
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, charts) is essential; knowledge of Python, R, SQL, or data visualization tools is a plus.
 Basic understanding of financial markets, derivatives (futures/options), and/or physical commodity supply chains.
 Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for preparing reports and interacting with teams.
 High attention to detail, ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment, and strong problem-solving abilities.
 Team player with a proactive, results-oriented attitude and eagerness to learn.
 Availability for full-time commitment during the internship period; some roles may require occasional overtime during market volatility.
 PreferredQualifications
 Prior internship or coursework in trading, risk management, logistics, or agriculture/energy markets.
 Familiarity with commodities (energy, metals, ags) or trading platforms.
 Language skills (e.g., Mandarin, English, Malay, Tamil) for international trading desks.
 Knowledge of statistical modeling or programming for quantitative roles.
 What You WillGain
 Deep exposure to global commodity markets and trading strategies.
 Practical understanding of risk, logistics, and commercial decision-making.
 Networking opportunities with industry professionals.
 Potential pathway to full-time employment upon successful completion.

jobs.description:
You can apply for this internship as a full time (5 days/week) internship or a part-time (4 days/week) internship.

 This internship duration is for 4 to 6 months and we’re looking to have someone join the team as early as 2 June (Tuesday).

 There is a possibility of converting to a contract role at the end of your internship. Alternatively, if you’re able to help out in a part-time capacity after your internship ends, we are open to that too.

For this internship, there’ll also be one kick-off and one closing session to help you formulate points for your resume.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 1. About you
We are looking for a multi-skilled person who fulfils the description below:

 - Detail-oriented: When you run quality control checks and schedule deliveries, you'll need to exercise extra scrutiny to ensure we can deliver the best version of our products to the right address. As a Operations and Intern, you’ll ensure that every step is executed correctly and hold our partners accountable to produce and deliver the orders timely﻿﻿
 - Professional problem solver: As a Operations intern, the team relies on you to be amongst the first line of contact with our suppliers. While we may have developed standard procedures for some scenarios, you must also be interested to think of ideas to solve new problems that come up
 - Accountable: There are many operational issues that can come up and mistakes that could happen, and we don’t have a culture of blaming each other. When such issues occur, you will not shy away from admitting your mistake, and you will fix the problem immediately without any reminders
 - Team-oriented: You will work with two Sales and Operations specialists closely, and we are looking for team players who look after one another
 2. Requirements
- This role is open to Singaporean/PR
- Paper qualifications aren’t important, so it doesn’t matter if you have a NITEC, Diploma or Degree ﻿﻿
- Enjoys engaging customers in written English, when we receive order fulfilment enquiries ﻿
- Passion in fashion and menswear is a bonus
- Working hours are Monday to Friday from 945am to 645pm for full time, and for Part-Time Wednesday will be your off day

 3. Roles & Responsibilities
- Manage fabric inventory (includes cutting fabric and conducting bi-weekly checks)
- Assist in managing production, partners, and implementing quality control
- Reply basic customer emails after learning our customer reply framework for order-related enquiries
- Conduct basic quality control checks (includes measurements checks using measuring tape)
- Conduct order fulfilment with the use of delivery softwares
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 For you to be able to manage these responsibilities well, we have a developed a 2-month training programme for you. This is an outline of what you can expect:

 Weeks 1-2:
﻿﻿- Be put through the customer journey- Introduction to the different product lines and designs we offer
- Learn about the different types of fabrics, and the various fabric suppliers that we work with
- Learn about the nuances of our inventory tracking process
 Weeks 3-4:﻿﻿
- Be introduced to our production partners, and learn their unique work flows
- Deep dive into the existing processes that we use to ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment
- Learn about our quality control framework so that you can conduct styles and measurements checks of all clothes, to ensure our standards are upheld﻿﻿﻿

 Weeks 5-6 :
﻿﻿- Learning our basic customer success framework which will help prepare you to respond to customers’ order-related enquiries
- Learning how to use the software to arrange international delivery
 Weeks 7-8:
﻿﻿- A review of what was taught to you from week 1 to 6 will be done, to see what areas you’d need more guidance with
- You will make a list of processes that require improvement, after which we will discuss and work on the more important processes

 If you’re doing a part-time internship, your training plan will be adjusted.
 Note: the salary range reflects a 4-day work week to a 5-day work week, and the amount varies slightly depending on your past experience.
